# Embed report

One report per engagement, written at the end of the embed and reviewed with the squad lead.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Squad | |
| Use case | |
| Embed period | start date - end date (weeks) |
| CoE engineer | |
| Squad owner after exit | |

## Starting point

What the squad had on day one: data, prototype, evaluation, skills on the team.

| | | | |

## Capability transferred

Which tasks the squad now does without the CoE, and how that was checked (for example: the squad changed
the prompt, re-recorded and passed the gate on their own in week N).
